title: Universal derived comparison for the identity coefficient tensor
statement: Let $J$ be an essentially small site, $O$ a commutative ring, $\ell\in O$, and $B_n=(O/(\ell^{n+1}))_J$ [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension]. Fix independently chosen unbounded derived categories and universal scalar extensions $LT_{mn}$ with counits $\epsilon_{mn}$ [lem-pur-coefficient-scalar-derived-adjunction]. Given an ordinary isomorphism $u:T_{nn}\cong\mathrm{id}$, there is an isomorphism $Lu:LT_{nn}\cong\mathrm{id}$. For every complex $P$, $(Lu)_{QP}=\epsilon_{nn,P}\,Q(u_P)$, where $u_P$ is the termwise ordinary unit comparison followed by the identity-complex comparison. This equation holds for all complexes, without a resolving-class restriction.

source.place: Tag 06XN: uniqueness of universal left derived functors

proof.text: Apply the ordinary unit isomorphism termwise, compose with the identity-complex comparison, and localize. The identity derived functor is the universal left derived functor of localization. Uniqueness gives the isomorphism from the prescribed scalar derived functor; its defining natural-transformation equation gives the stated formula.
